message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# write a trace matching observed MMR overflow/allocator issue as best as possible
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"jbig2.c","function":"jbig2_data_in","line":275,"var":"ctx->buf + ctx->buf_rd_ix","code":"if (memcmp(ctx->buf + ctx->buf_rd_ix, jbig2_id_string, 8)) return jbig2_error(ctx, JBIG2_SEVERITY_FATAL, -1, \"not a JBIG2 file header\");","note":"The input preserves the JBIG2 magic bytes so the parser accepts the file and processes its segments."},
{"step":2,"file":"jbig2_symbol_dict.c","function":"jbig2_symbol_dictionary","line":694,"var":"BMSIZE","code":"code = jbig2_decode_generic_mmr(ctx, segment, &rparams, data + jbig2_huffman_offset(hs), BMSIZE, image);","note":"The crafted symbol dictionary reaches the MMR bitmap decode path with the remaining encoded bytes as the MMR buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_init","line":71,"var":"mmr->size","code":"mmr->size = size;","note":"The MMR decoder stores the provided buffer length as the limit for prebuffered reads."},
{"step":4,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":86,"var":"mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4]","code":"if (mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size) mmr->word |= (mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4] << mmr->bit_index);","note":"As decoding nears the end of the supplied buffer, refill stops pulling bytes from the input."},
{"step":5,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":88,"var":"mmr->data_index","code":"mmr->data_index++;","note":"The internal consumed-byte cursor still advances even when no new byte was actually read."},
{"step":6,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_generic_mmr","line":1147,"var":"*consumed_bytes","code":"*consumed_bytes += mmr.data_index + (mmr.bit_index >> 3) + (mmr.bit_index > 0 ? 1 : 0);","note":"The inflated cursor value is reported to the caller as consumed bytes, exceeding the bytes really fetched from the buffer."},
{"step":7,"file":"jbig2_symbol_dict.c","function":"jbig2_symbol_dictionary","line":702,"var":"jbig2_huffman_advance(hs, BMSIZE)","code":"code = jbig2_huffman_advance(hs, BMSIZE);","note":"The caller advances the Huffman stream by the bitmap size after MMR decoding, which leaves the remaining input position inconsistent with the inflated consumption report."},
{"step":8,"file":"jbig2_symbol_dict.c","function":"jbig2_symbol_dictionary","line":666,"var":"size - jbig2_huffman_offset(hs)","code":"if (size < jbig2_huffman_offset(hs) || (size - jbig2_huffman_offset(hs) < (size_t) image->height * stride) || (size < jbig2_huffman_offset(hs))) {","note":"The desynchronized stream state causes later size calculations to go wrong; the observed failure is an oversized allocation request from corrupted dimensions/size propagation."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
PY
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json && echo '--- done'
